purpose: Third-party UI assets vendored for the loopback-only operator dashboard (templates/dashboard.html). Served only through web_app.py's loopback-guarded /assets/{name} allowlist route; no CDN reference remains.

assets.notes: adminlte.min.css compiles in Bootstrap 5.3 CSS, so Bootstrap's MIT license is carried alongside. adminlte.min.js (added 2026-09-27, same verified v4.9.1 tarball) provides the CardWidget collapse behaviour through a document-level click handler; it is standalone vanilla JS with no dependency on Bootstrap's JavaScript, which remains unvendored. Its only storage use is localStorage for sidebar state (this page has no sidebar) and for the ColorMode theme; the dashboard sets data-lte-color-mode="off" on <html>, which disables ColorMode entirely, so the declared dark theme is never overridden and no theme is read or written. Its AccessibilityManager adds a live region, visually hidden skip links and landmark roles. Both files' trailing sourceMappingURL comments point at local .map files that are not vendored; browsers only request them with devtools open, and the request stays on loopback (404).
License file only; Bootstrap's CSS reaches the page through adminlte.min.css.
